description: Live like a local in Paris's most beloved neighborhood. Canal Saint-Martin a 2-min walk away, Place de la République (5 metro lines) 5 min away, a covered food market and one of Paris's most awarded bakeries right around the corner. 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, up to 8 guests. 1st floor with elevator (rare in Paris!) in a renovated Haussmann building: herringbone parquet floors, high ceilings, fully equipped kitchen, dining table for 8, smart TV, high-speed Wi-Fi.The spaceWelcome to this exceptional Haussmann apartment in the heart of the 10th arrondissement, a 2-minute walk from the Canal Saint-Martin and 5 minutes from Place de la République. A true Parisian retreat for families or groups of friends, set in one of the most vibrant and authentic neighbourhoods of Paris.🏛️ THE APARTMENTLocated on the 1st floor of a Haussmann building with elevator — a rare luxury in Paris.The apartment showcases all the charm of old Paris: herringbone parquet flooring, high ceilings, spectacular rococo mouldings, two period fireplaces (one in brown-red marble, the other in carved wood), large multi-pane windows with interior shutters and wrought-iron Juliet balconies.The décor elegantly blends these original features with refined contemporary furniture.🛋️ DOUBLE LIVING ROOM & DINING ROOMThe heart of the apartment: a true double living room en enfilade, bathed in light through six large windows facing the street.On one side, a relaxing lounge with deep sofas, a grand gilded mirror and a fireplace topped with musical instruments — banjo, guitar, vinyl records.On the other side, the TV lounge with smart TV and sound system, opening onto the dining room.The dining room, enhanced by a second hand-carved wooden fireplace, comfortably seats up to 8 guests around a generous table — perfect for shar
